Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
Position: C++ / Embedded Software Architect
 Location: On-Site (Cluj-Napoca, Romania)
 Seniority: Architect Level
 Language: English
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced C++ / Embedded Software Architect to act as a Technical Anchor across multiple subsystems. This is an on-site position , based in Cluj-Napoca .
 The role requires strong hands-on expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) , with a focus on Qt desktop applications and/or real-time systems such as QNX , as well as embedded Linux and Windows IoT / kiosk environments , combined with architect-level ownership of complex software solutions.
 You will be responsible for defining and driving technical architecture across subsystems, establishing engineering standards, and ensuring high levels of software quality, maintainability, and consistency throughout the development lifecycle.
 The role also requires the active use of Agentic AI as part of the software engineering and development workflow. Previous experience in a safety-critica l or regulated environment , such as automotive or medical devices , is considered a strong advantage.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Software Architecture & Technical Leadership 
Define and drive software architecture across multiple components and subsystems
Act as a Technical Anchor, providing architectural direction and ensuring consistency across development teams
Own technical decisions across the software development lifecycle
Translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable and maintainable software architectures
Support development teams in solving complex technical and cross-subsystem challenges
 C++ & Embedded Development 
Design and develop high-quality software using modern C++ (C++17 or later)
Design and develop desktop GUI applications with Qt
Design and develop applications for Windows IoT / kiosk and embedded Linux environments
Design and develop software running on QNX real-time operating systems
Ensure portability, performance, reliability, and maintainability across supported platforms
 Agentic AI & Engineering Efficiency 
Actively use Agentic AI within software engineering and development workflows
Promote effective and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across teams
 Technical Requirements 
 Must-have 
8+ years of professional software development experience, including significant experience at Architect / Technical Lead level
Strong hands-on expertise in modern C++
Hands-on experience with Qt and/or QNX / other RTOS
Experience developing applications for embedded Linux and/or Windows IoT / kiosk environments
Active hands-on use of Agentic AI in software engineering and development workflows
Fluent English communication skills
 Nice-to-have 
Previous experience developing software in a safety-critical or regulated environment, such as automotive (ISO 26262 / ASPICE) or industrial (IEC 61508); MedTech / Medical Devices experience under IEC 62304 (Class B or C) is a strong advantage
Familiarity with FPGA development, particularly Xilinx or Intel toolchains
Experience with both Qt and QNX / other RTOS
Knowledge of server-side web development, including REST APIs and containerisation
Proficiency in authoring Azure DevOps (ADO) YAML pipelines
Familiarity with Artifactory integration within development and CI/CD pipelines
Hands-on knowledge of the Conan 2 package manager
Knowledge of package versioning and pre-release conventions
 Soft Skills 
Strong technical leadership and decision-making capabilities
Excellent analytical and structured problem-solving skills
High level of responsibility and end-to-end ownership
Ability to communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong collaboration skills across development teams and technical disciplines
Ability to provide technical guidance
 Education 
University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, or a related field
